name: Eclipse P2 update sites
auth: This headless director recipe uses an explicit server-side anonymous READ grant on the selected repository. Anonymous access is denied by default: an operator must enable anonymous access AND grant read permission to this repository. Do not grant write permission. No caller token is embedded in the repository URL. Private-user Eclipse secure-storage setup is not covered by this recipe.
fresh_home: Create a new AW_WORK with mktemp -d for every run; client configuration, downloads and caches in the commands stay under this directory. Do not reuse it to prove a fresh download. Remove the temporary directory after use.
prerequisites: An operator-approved anonymous READ policy on the particular remote/virtual repository, or a separately secured authenticating gateway operated for that client.
A trusted HTTPS certificate and a compatible Eclipse installation unit.

configure.note: Run the pinned Eclipse installation with a new configuration/workspace/destination. The server must explicitly authorize anonymous read on this repository, as described below.

publish.note: P2 supports remote and virtual repositories only. Publish the update site to its upstream source; this endpoint is a resolver/cache.

install.note: Resolve through an operator-approved remote or virtual P2 site.

steps.code: env HOME="$AW_WORK/home" eclipse -nosplash -consoleLog -configuration "$AW_WORK/configuration" -data "$AW_WORK/workspace" -application org.eclipse.equinox.p2.director -repository "$AW_URL/artifactory/$AW_REPO/" -installIU org.eclipse.glsp.layout.source/2.7.0 -destination "$AW_WORK/installed" -profile AWRecipe -p2.os linux -p2.ws gtk -p2.arch x86_64 -vmargs -Duser.home="$AW_WORK/home"
steps.note: Select the installation unit/version appropriate to the site. The JVM must trust the HTTPS endpoint; use an operator-approved truststore for a private CA.

limitations: Local and federated P2 classes are unsupported.
An anonymous grant makes the allowed repository content publicly readable; only use it for content the operator intends to expose.
Earlier P2 tests used a TLS credential-injecting gateway; the explicit-grant recipe has a separate acceptance scenario.

contains: a fresh P2 client installs only while the repository read grant exists
